breakdown.description: A horizontal traction on the vertical edge x = 0 is reinterpreted as tangential shear, even though it is normal to that edge
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency correctly. The original prompt specified a horizontal traction (σ_xx=4000 Pa) on the vertical edge (x=0) but then incorrectly asked to interpret it as shear. The ground truth corrects this by removing the incorrect interpretation, leaving the load as a normal traction in the x-direction. The agent, however, incorrectly changed the load to a 'shear traction of 4000 Pa in the positive y-direction', which is an entirely different boundary condition and does not match the ground truth.
